title: IBM security advisory (AV26-1040)
description: As of October 13, 2026, IBM is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
WebSphere Application Server
	Prior to or equal to 8.5
Prior to or equal to 9.0

WebSphere Application Server - Liberty
	Prior to or equal to 26.0.0.10

mcp-context-forge
	Prior to or equal to 1.0.2
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
